material_findings.title: FF01 k>2/reverse-distribution claim is not supported by ExactConditionalSupportProfile
material_findings.failure: The actual object is a fixed two-target Q86B->Q86A count relation with participant_cardinality=2 and no ratio calculation; it cannot produce P(Y1..Yk|D,U,W), reverse P(D|Y,U,W), role/position contrasts or branch/recursive conditionals. R3-RES-008 itself only claims a conditional association/profile.
material_findings.smallest_correction: Split FF01-2 (existing exact count profile) from a versioned FF01-k derived-product contract with exact roles/keys, reverse risk basis, ratio/coverage and first consumer; if absent, grade k>2/reverse CONDITIONAL_EXTENSION/OWNER_HELD, not CONCEPTUALLY_ACCOMMODATED via the existing function. Add falsifier and R3-RES entry.

material_findings.title: C11 source-preservation claim is overbroad at field level
actual_sources: rawlsing_next/pre553_empirical_objects.py lines 503-512 EmpiricalUniverse, 548-555 RoutingEligibilityFact, 559-567 WeightMeasureFact, 696-706 EmpiricalFact
material_findings.failure: QuestionVariableBinding has no option/form/routing field; EmpiricalUniverse has respondent_namespace but no household/roster namespace; WeightMeasureFact has design/estimand authority refs but no PSU/strata/variance; EmpiricalFact has uncertainty_method_or_typed_state, not numeric variance. The decision asserts C11 preserves these without distinguishing exact C11 bytes, external codebook/source artifact, and unavailable/typed-absent.
material_findings.smallest_correction: Add an INSPECTED_CODE field map and R3-RES entry: C11 native refs/version/routing state; external source/codebook/questionnaire for original-language option/form/ballot; household/roster not canonical unless a source-specific projection is defined; PSU/strata/variance/numeric uncertainty external or typed-absent. Correct §6.1/§6.3/§7 and R3-CAP-01/03.

material_findings.title: Architecture decision does not cite R3-RES IDs
actual_sources: R3_RESEARCH_LEDGER.jsonl cross_refs point to R3-CAP-* only
material_findings.failure: The 22-entry ledger is substantive, but the architecture decision is not linked to the research IDs it relies on; the ledger is parallel rather than reverse-cited from the decision.
material_findings.smallest_correction: Add a research_refs column to the capability rows and explicit R3-RES citations in each decision section; add the missing source-field/FF01 entries and reverse links. No new research required.

material_findings.title: Typed-access views are stronger than their own R3-RES-021 grade
actual_sources: EmpiricalCoordinateFact native_coordinate_ref/time; WeightMeasureFact weight_basis_id/effective_scope; RoutingEligibilityFact question/target/risk_set
material_findings.failure: The view is a plausible direction, but the exact join keys for coordinate/weight/routing families and the native-evaluator adapter are not specified; R3-RES-021 itself grades the extension open/conditional.
material_findings.smallest_correction: Supply the exact per-family key/ref map and adapter contract, or downgrade the view-specific claim to CONDITIONAL_EXTENSION while retaining the architectural direction.

material_findings.title: F6 design variance/PSU/strata need explicit external hold
material_findings.failure: F6 is correctly owner-held, but the exact design inputs absent from C11 are not named; a reader may infer WeightMeasureFact contains design variance/PSU/strata.
material_findings.smallest_correction: State explicitly that C11 has design/estimand authority refs and universe/frame labels only; PSU/strata/replicate weights/design variance and numeric uncertainty are external F6 inputs or typed-absent.
